responsibility: Defines the CR16-specific command-line target options and their mapping into GCC target flags and variables. It introduces switches for simulator runtime selection, bit and MAC instruction availability, architecture variant choice, integer width, debugging of addresses, and the CR16 data model, supplying the option table that drives backend configuration before code generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-definition file for the CR16 backend, listing target switches such as msim, mbit-ops, mmac, mdata-model, architecture selection, and mint32 and mapping them to backend flags/variables. Unlike cr16.c, cr16.h, and cr16.md, it does not implement code generation or ABI rules directly; it defines the user-selectable knobs that configure those other same-stem files.
